title: DevAcademy routes/<track>.yaml
description: Editor aid only. The C# ContentValidator is authoritative. Entry lessons by prior knowledge and the track's competency checks.

track.description: Track id; must equal the file name.

beginner.description: Lesson id where an absolute beginner starts (a level-0 course).

programmer.description: Lesson id where a learner who knows another language starts.

check.description: Lesson id of the check (has assessmentFor).

after.description: Competencies whose checks are suggested first; acyclic.
